items.headline: Aiden Flora accounts for 5 TDs as Iowa State outlasts West Virginia in a wild 45-42 victory
items.description: — Aiden Flora accounted for five touchdowns, including the go-ahead score with 1:57 left, and Iowa State held off West Virginia 45-42 Saturday in a wild game in which the teams combined for over 1,000 yards of offense.
